TYPE - 1 NARRATIVE AND PLANS
FOR THE PROPOSED ZONING CHANGE
AT 640-652 W. 47th STREET, CHICAGO, 60609

The Applicant seeks a zoning change from B1-1 (Neighborhood Shopping District) to C1-1
(Neighborhood Commercial District) in order to allow the temporary use of the site for the
storage of construction equipment and vehicles for up to 24 months. No new construction is

proposed.
